from: October book, night 23 (Say Not, I Am a Child)
p1: The Lord chose young Jeremiah to tell people Heavenly Father’s words. Jeremiah felt too little. He said, “Oh, Lord, I cannot speak. I am a child.”
The Lord said, “Do not say, ‘I am a child.’ Go where I send you. Say what I tell you.”
He said, “Do not be afraid, for I am with you.” Then the Lord reached out His hand and touched Jeremiah’s mouth.
p2: The Lord said, “I have put My words in your mouth.” Jeremiah did not have to find the words by himself. The Lord was Jesus, and He helps the ones He calls.
You are never too little to help Jesus. When you feel shy, He can help you find kind and true words.
old: Jeremiah still felt small. He did not think he had one good word inside him to say to the people.
Then Heavenly Father reached out and gently touched Jeremiah’s mouth. “I have put My words in your mouth,” He said.
Jeremiah did not have to make up the words by himself. Heavenly Father gave them to him, like warm bread put into open hands.
Then Heavenly Father sent Jeremiah to the people to build up and to plant. That means his words would help good things grow, like a gardener planting little trees in good ground.
When you do not know what to say, you can ask Heavenly Father. He is close to you tonight. You never have to find kind words all alone.
